data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 2443c4260ac8e6562f7eb863a22030fd62882ad1

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (post-merge cleanup)

#### Expected Behavior

After PR #110 (story 771d) merged, the .test-index entry for runner.py should include all RED test markers written as part of the 771d TDD cycle, including: test_read_config_int_handles_whitespace_around_equals, test_clamp_schema_correction_attempts_rejects_negative, test_get_schema_correction_max_attempts_end_to_end, test_get_schema_correction_max_attempts_clamps_negative, test_get_schema_correction_max_attempts_clamps_above_ceiling.

Also: validate-config.sh review.* keys should be sorted alphabetically in KNOWN_KEYS array per established convention.

#### Actual Behavior

PR #110 was merged at HEAD=6bf1772a4d. Post-merge commits 9fe6522f62 and 71196a6659 (which added the 5 missing markers and the sort fix) were NOT included in the merge. These 2 commits remain on the story branch only.

The 5 test functions exist in test_runner_smoke.py and pass (GREEN), but are not tracked in the .test-index RED marker list. The pre-commit test gate will treat them as untracked (not enforced as RED during future development against runner.py).
data.title: test-index: 5 RED markers missing from runner.py entry after 771d story PR merge
